personas.name: Technician / Research Technical Professional
personas.tip: AHRC's Curiosity and Catalyst awards name technicians as welcome leads. You need a PhD or equivalent research experience, argued in your narrative CV. On someone else's bid, choose Specialist rather than Technician if you bring intellectual input. Both roles are costed.

personas.name: Practitioner, curator or archivist on staff
personas.tip: You don't need an academic post to lead Curiosity or Catalyst. You must be employed by an eligible research organisation, or have a formal arrangement with one, for the length of the grant.

personas.name: Early career researcher
personas.tip: Catalyst is for first-time leads, and early-career fellowships don't count against you. Future Leaders Fellowships (round 12 expected Feb 2027) support moving to independence.

personas.name: Academic, not yet a project lead
personas.tip: Catalyst (£100k–£300k) is built for first-time leads; being a co-lead or mentor before doesn't count against you. Knowledge Transfer Partnerships let you lead a partnership with a company.

personas.name: Experienced project lead
personas.tip: You can't lead Catalyst, but you can be a co-lead or mentor. Standard grants, Large Grants, international bids and infrastructure calls such as CoSTAR need experienced leads. Give technicians the right named role.

personas.name: Doctoral student
personas.tip: Doctoral students can't lead these grants. AHRC CreaTech ICURe Discover explicitly includes research students, and you can be named as a doctoral student in a project team.

personas.name: Research office or professional staff
personas.tip: Professional Enabling Staff is a named, costed role covering finance, marketing and partnership work. AHRC's July 2026 town hall told applicants to justify professional support as a cost.

personas.name: External partner (business or cultural organisation)
personas.tip: Businesses lead most Innovate UK calls, with universities as partners. On AHRC bids you are a project partner giving cash or in-kind support; on AHRC Large Grants you can be a formal co-lead. A KTP places a graduate in your company.
